**The Economy as an Evolving Complex System IV**. Co-edited with Marco Pangallo, Jenna Bednar, Eric D. Beinhocker, Jagoda Kaszowska-Mojsa, François Lafond, Penny Mealy, Anton Pichler, and J. Doyne Farmer. The volume revisits the complexity economics research program launched at the Santa Fe Institute in 1987 — treating economies as adaptive, out-of-equilibrium systems rather than as systems that settle into equilibrium — and synthesizes nearly four decades of work across seven themes: foundational theory, methodologies, macroeconomics and finance, climate and sustainability, inequality and labor, innovation and technological change, and political economy and policy. [Read more](https://www.sfipress.org/books/eecs-iv)
